description: Set A' regime map, D_s x b_R (n_R = n = 1). Fronts outrun their signal below D_s,crit ~ 4.2-4.9 (§ 3.7); beyond it the resistance ceiling decides: b_eff_inf = 5 - (5 - b_R) phi_inf with phi_inf = 0.952, so a stall needs b_R < 0.80, and larger b_R gives a ceiling slow wave (§ 3.6). RNA-protein host response of the first review's revision of Oct 24 2026 (eq. 22); uses the density cutoff (no infection below V_ext = p_ext, removal at rate 5).
